Class Game

java.lang.Object
simscli.game.Game
public final class Game extends Object
Main Game orchestrator: delegates to focused managers for clean architecture. Follows facade pattern - coordinates multiple managers without mixing concerns. Managers: - SimManager: Sim lifecycle (creation, tracking, removal) - LocationManager: Locations and travel - TimeManager: Game clock and time advancement - ActionExecutor: Action performance and job changes - LoanManager: Loan overdues and repossessions
